Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 8

“For I see nothing that could drive away this grief which withers my senses — not unrivalled prosperity on earth, nor even lordship over the gods.”

Arjuna measures his sorrow against the largest prizes he can imagine and finds them too small. It is a precise admission: this is not a problem that wealth or power can touch.
